name: workout-dumbbell-holder
description: Internal-plug + external-sleeve clip-on cradle that mounts a rubber-coated dumbbell vertically on a treadmill rectangular extrusion. Fork plate below rail-top (20 mm offset) with top + bottom quarter-cylinder buttresses and curved bending-stiffness ribs. CF-reinforced filament; Fusion 360 modeling.

tolerances.note: 1.0 mm/side user-specified clearance on both plug axes (generous sliding fit). CF-reinforced filament may shrink less than PLA — test pocket print required before full part.

loadCase.description: Cantilever bending: 3 lb (1.36 kg) rubber-coated dumbbell hangs in the saddle, weight acts at the saddle center in gravity direction (Fusion -Z). Holder is fixed in/around the treadmill rail via plug + sleeve. Critical sections analyzed: plug-root (where the plug emerges from the flange) and fork-plate-root (where the fork plate cantilever emerges from the sleeve).

forces.comment: 3 lb dumbbell × 9.81 m/s² = 13.3 N. Applied at saddle center (Y=90 from rail axis, Z=-20 below flange-top per saddle_center_z_below_flange_top).

criticalSections.name: plug-root
criticalSections.comment: Hollow rectangular plug walls (3 mm CF minimum) at the plug-to-flange transition. Width is X span (perpendicular to cantilever-bending direction); height is Y span (the dimension cubed in bh³/12, since bending stress acts along the cantilever +Y axis). In plug-vertical print orientation the bending moment is transmitted through layer interfaces at this junction — interlayer derate applies as a conservative bound.

criticalSections.name: fork-plate-root
criticalSections.comment: Fork plate at the sleeve-fork junction (Y=31.25). Width is X span (post-v3.4 recentering, 88.5 → 83.5 mm); height is Z span (12 mm plate thickness — the bending depth). Print-review flagged this as the worst-case inter-layer tension location in plug-vertical print orientation. Closed-form rect is a simplification — the actual section is reinforced by top + bottom buttresses + ribs which a beam-theory calc ignores; FEA recommended to recover the buttress contribution.

params.sleeve_length_note: Extended from 30 mm (v3) to 48 mm in v3.3 to provide landing surface for the bottom buttress.
params.sleeve_minus_x_wall_removed_reason: Treadmill control panel structure abuts the rail on the -X side per user-supplied reference photo.
params.fork_plate_x_note: Post v3.4 recentering. −X cut retained for console clearance; +X trimmed to match.
params.top_buttress_tangent_a: Y=+31.25, Z=0 (flange-top outer +Y edge — tangent vertical)
params.bottom_ribs_profile: curved fin — full depth at inner end (Y=+31.25), tapers to zero at outer end (Y=+105)
params.bore_clear: confirmed — open end, no internal obstruction

testPrintCandidates.reason: 1.0 mm/side clearance chosen conservatively for CF-reinforced filament. Test pocket (30 mm deep, full cross-section) before the full part.
R23 saddle arc accuracy and plate surface quality should be verified before committing to the full part.
r=22 quarter-cylinder buttress geometry on CF-reinforced filament — verify surface quality and layer adhesion at the arc transition.
